claims.quote: the Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe
claims.statement: The Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe.

claims.quote: with Holyrood not giving people who know their areas best enough of a say
claims.statement: Holyrood does not give people who know their areas best enough of a say.

claims.quote: the next stage of devolution should place more decision-making in the hands of Scotland’s regions and cities to drive reindustrialisation
claims.statement: The next stage of devolution should place more decision-making in the hands of Scotland's regions and cities to drive reindustrialisation.

claims.quote: Through No10 North, we are rewiring the state
claims.statement: Through No10 North, the Government is rewiring the state.

claims.quote: there is no limit to what we can achieve for the Scottish people
claims.statement: With the Scottish Government and UK Government working together, there is no limit to what can be achieved for the Scottish people.

claims.quote: Devolution has done a great deal, but power was never supposed to stop at the doors of the Scottish Parliament
claims.statement: Devolution has done a great deal, but power was never supposed to stop at the doors of the Scottish Parliament.

claims.quote: People in North Lanarkshire, in Fife or in the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister
claims.statement: People in North Lanarkshire, Fife and the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister.

claims.quote: Two governments, one goal - good jobs and real opportunity in every corner of Scotland
claims.statement: Two governments with one goal can deliver good jobs and real opportunity in every corner of Scotland.

claims.quote: the Scotland Office is ready to roll up its sleeves alongside them to make it happen
claims.statement: The Scotland Office is ready to work alongside the Scottish Government to make the Prime Minister's offer happen.
